name: crewplane
description: Local orchestration for coding agents across harnesses.

scripts.build: bun scripts/embed.ts && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig src/cli.ts --outfile dist/crewplane
scripts.build:release: bun scripts/embed.ts && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --define 'process.env.CREWPLANE_RELEASE_BUILD="1"' src/cli.ts --outfile dist/crewplane
scripts.test: bun run build && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:binary
